cohort: Pregnant women with a previous low-segment cesarean delivery and a singleton pregnancy with cephalic presentation attending Dr Rajendra Prasad Government Medical College, Kangra, India, in 2013
finding: Under strict supervision, TOLAC was found to be a reasonable option with a 79.6% success rate in rural India.
mod_finding: Blood loss was significantly lower among women with normal vaginal delivery than among those who underwent cesarean, and the proportion of neonates who had to be admitted to intensive care did not differ significantly by mode of delivery.
